Regression snapshots from the local nql and slopwatch workspaces:
- QueryResultRow.java: typed row access, null handling and SQL value formatting.
- KeyedPath.java: component validation, list copying and placement policy.
- workspace.go.txt: canonical/private filesystem roots and manifest policy.

These exercise material source-analysis uncertainty without establishing an
adverse architectural finding. Numeric zero means no supported defect, not
